newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-EDINBURGH PROP FAYERS SUSPENDED FOR FOUR YEARS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-EDINBURGH PROP FAYERS SUSPENDED FOR FOUR YEARS.

text.p: Edinburgh Academicals prop Jason Fayers has been suspended for four years after a lineout incident in a match against Kelso.
The incident is also being investigated by the police.
Kelso prop Brian Cassie was suspended for one year by the Scottish Rugby Union (SRU) after a separate incident in the same match.
"The sentences reflect both the nature of the offences and the SRU's determination to send the clearest of signals that foul play has no place in rugby union," a SRU statement said on Monday.
